title: Minimal real SWAP5 + MODFLOW6 + Ribasim transactional composition with valid non-owning output cadence

ribasim.solver_saveat_semantics: start and end only; not a management cadence

hypotheses: The real SWAP management decision requests exactly 0.0036 cm over the 1e-4-day event.
Real Ribasim initializes and advances the 8.64-second window with saveat=Inf while allocation.dt remains 8.64 seconds.
Real Ribasim allocates and physically supplies the full request within the RM09 full-realization envelope.
Discarded Ribasim candidate A leaves the accepted witness unchanged and candidate B replays identically.
The RM10 typed realization receipt binds the Ribasim return to the exact SWAP management origin.
Zero-cover Rutter processing returns net irrigation equal to gross physical supply.
Real Richards SWAP with top irrigation active and live MODFLOW6 fixed-interface coupling converges inside the inherited F-GC44 transaction envelope.
Rejected Richards/MODFLOW correctors do not mutate accepted SWAP state or groundwater ledger.
Surface-water and groundwater ledgers remain separate and each close exactly once.
Richards SWAP and management SWAP revisions each advance exactly once after all preflights.
Complete prepublication replay from the same accepted origins reproduces surface supply, management net irrigation, groundwater endpoint and transfer ledgers.
failure_rule: Do not modify the physical 8.64-second window, irrigation quantity, groundwater envelope, model pins or tolerances after execution. Only technical harness failures may be repaired automatically.
nonclaims: No groundwater influence on a later management demand.
No arbitrary Ribasim topology or competing demand.
No production iMOD Coupler driver integration.
No native Ribasim checkpoint API is claimed.
